floorPlans.introduction: Browse the complete Alder sheets published by Deyaar, including the original unit-position keys.
floorPlans.note: Published totals include exterior areas. The printed 2 BR Type 04-t total is 1,740 sq ft, while the displayed components sum to 1,730. The 2 BR Type 02 total also differs from its components by 1 sq ft. The selector retains the published totals. Confirm the specific home’s contractual area.

review.gallery: 10 native-resolution renders from the dedicated Alder brochure. Shared community amenities are identified in the captions. The three images on Deyaar’s Ivy/Alder construction update are renders, so the selection uses the brochure originals.
review.location: Physical page 11 marks the shared ParkFive community. It publishes 15 minutes to Dubai Exhibition Centre/Expo City and 25 minutes to Dubai airport. The map and text were visually checked. The page uses named directions because a verified building entrance point was unavailable.
review.floorPlans: 15 complete original plan sheets. Each type and printed total was visually checked. The printed 2 BR Type 04-t total is 1,740 sq ft, while the displayed components sum to 1,730. The 2 BR Type 02 total also differs from its components by 1 sq ft. The selector retains the published totals.
